responsibility: Declares the GNU Modula-2 SYSTEM runtime interface for low-level multiword set operations, exporting constants about byte and word sizes and the helper routines that implement runtime SHIFT and ROTATE behavior when operations cannot be fully inlined by the compiler. This header defines the backend-facing contract for system-dependent set bit manipulation rather than general runtime startup or storage services.
same_name_distinction: Unlike GSYSTEM.cc's dummy boot stub, this header defines the real SYSTEM interface expected by clients: constants and prototypes for multiword set SHIFT and ROTATE helpers. It is the contract for low-level set operations, not the empty linkage scaffold implemented in the .cc file.
